Name: Day1_BeastTide
EventDescription: As the sun sets, waves of corrupted beasts pour from the Dark Forest. Villagers barricade their homes while guards scramble to hold the perimeter.

Name: Day4_Festival
EventDescription: The beast tide has passed. Survivors gather to celebrate, mourn the fallen, and share stories of bravery.

Name: Day7_DemonInvasion
EventDescription: The earth trembles as a demon lord awakens beneath the mountain. Dark energy corrupts nearby wildlife and drives weaker NPCs mad with fear.

Name: Day6_Plague
EventDescription: A mysterious plague spreads through the market district. Merchants close shops, healers are overwhelmed, and the temple priest blames dark magic.

Name: Day10_FactionWar
EventDescription: Peace negotiations collapse. Orc and Human factions mobilize for open warfare along the river border. Civilians flee to neutral ground.
